ptzCameras.notes: 1/2.8-inch 4K Exmor CMOS, 12x. Dual-lens auto-tracking system: main PTZ lens specs only. Panoramic tracking module is a tracking sensor, not a recording lens; out of scope. 1/2.8-inch CMOS, 30x. HFOV 62.3°/2.5° from averusa.com product page. Note: AVer publishes focal range 3.9–46.8mm with 30x optical zoom; these values are mutually inconsistent (3.9mm × 30 ≠ 46.8mm). Optically-equivalent TR335N publishes 4.5–135mm/30x which is consistent; the focal range on averusa.com for TR335 appears to be a data error. HFOV 62.3°/2.5° is consistent across sources and is the app-critical value. Current.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 22x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus a fixed 110-degree panoramic tracking sensor. DC-powered (no PoE). AVer datasheet prints only an unreliable diagonal FOV (76/5, identical to the 30x TR530, physically impossible); HFOV 65/3.1 uses the shared-family wide (65, per PTC500+/PTC115+) plus focal+sensor geometry for the 94.6mm tele. Discontinued.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 30x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus a fixed panoramic tracking sensor. DC-powered. AVer datasheet prints only an unreliable diagonal FOV (76/5, identical to the 22x TR320); HFOV 65/2.3 taken from the identical 30x/4.3-129 lens published by PTC500+ (65/2.3) and PTC330 (65.1/2.34). Discontinued.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 30x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus fixed 120-degree panoramic sensor. DC-powered. Non-AI zone tracking (1 target zone plus 8 blocking zones). HFOV 65/2.3 from the AVer brochure diagonal FOV 72.9/2.64 converted (16:9), consistent with PTC500+ published 65/2.3. Discontinued.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 30x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus fixed 120-degree panoramic sensor. DC-powered. AVer datasheet prints only a coarse diagonal FOV (76/3); HFOV 65/2.3 taken from the identical 30x/4.3-129 lens published by PTC500+. Discontinued.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 30x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus fixed 120-degree panoramic sensor. USB plus PoE+ added in the Plus revision. HFOV 65/2.3 published (horizontal) on the AVer product page, aperture F1.6-4.7. Discontinued.

Dual-lens auto-tracking: 15x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 2MP) plus fixed 120-degree panoramic sensor. DC-powered. AVer datasheet prints only a coarse diagonal FOV (76/5); HFOV 65/4.3 taken from the identical 15x/4.3-64.5 lens published by PTC115+ (65/4.3). Discontinued.
Dual-lens auto-tracking: 15x PTZ tele lens (1/2.8-inch 1080p 2MP) plus fixed 120-degree panoramic sensor. USB + PoE+. HFOV 65/4.3 from the AVer PTC115+ datasheet (published horizontal). Discontinued.

1/2.8-inch Sony Exmor CMOS 2MP, 12x optical (3.9-46.8mm), 1080p60. Built-in AI tracking (SmartShoot/SmartFrame).
